A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–L are available and support reliable comparison despite pagination changes.

before.justification: V1 reports original TR-LV and TR-SOCM experiments on diffusion-based sampling, molecular transitions, diffusion-model fine-tuning, and classical control problems.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and their quantitative and qualitative results, including Table 1 and Figures 2–11.

M1.justification: The KL-constrained update, TR-LV/TR-SOCM losses, model architectures, and buffer-based algorithm are retained. Corrections to derived formulas and pseudocode restore consistency with existing definitions rather than establish a different method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Gaussian-mixture and Many Well targets, Alanine Dipeptide and Chignolin transitions, Stable Diffusion 1.5 fine-tuning, and easy/hard quadratic OU problems. Appendix coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged within corresponding experiments: RE/CE/LV/AM/SOCM in the main sampling study, UMD/SMD/PIPS/TPS-DPS in molecular sampling, and AM in fine-tuning. Figure 3 relabels existing ablation variants without adding or removing comparators.

E3.justification: Training budgets, architectures, sample counts, evaluation metrics, model-selection procedures, and ODE/SDE inference settings are retained. The normalization identity correction in Appendix I.2 does not change the stated Monte Carlo estimator.

E4.justification: Figure 3 revises the reported outcomes of the existing replay-buffer and fixed-multiplier ablation by reassigning curve labels. No new ablation question is introduced; trust-region-bound sensitivity and other supplementary analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Sampling and classical-control results still use four seeds, while molecular comparisons retain three-seed reporting and means/standard deviations. No new uncertainty-estimation practice, run count, or significance test is introduced.

E6.justification: In Figure 3's right panel, the purple curve changes from LV to TR-LV and the green curve from TR-LV to LV, reversing their reported ranking. The blue/orange buffer-only and fixed-lambda labels also swap. Curve coordinates and other reported results are unchanged; this is a localized attribution correction, not a newly measured performance gain.

T1.justification: V2 corrects Proposition 2.5's integration limit, adds conditioning and an outer expectation in Equation (14), repairs the Lagrangian expansion in Appendix E.4 and the specialized adjoint formula in G.5, and removes an incorrect normalization equality in I.2. It also deletes v1's additional control-equivalence derivation, Equations (73)–(79), while retaining Proposition E.2. The central annealing and Fisher–Rao results remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about trust-region measure transport, geometric annealing, approximately equidistant Fisher–Rao steps, and improved sampling stability and efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of stability, mode collapse, and sample efficiency are retained. The CPU/GPU buffer-transfer limitation in Appendix C.2 and high-dimensional mode-collapse qualification in I.3 are unchanged.

D1.justification: Algorithm 2 explicitly identifies the inner-loop count as gradient steps per trust-region iteration and clarifies summation grouping in the discretized log-variance estimator. Hyperparameters, hardware descriptions, and repository-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V2 adds citations to TROLL, Importance Corrected Neural JKO Sampling, Learning Boltzmann Generators via Constrained Mass Transport, and MDNS in Section 4 and Appendix C.1. The surrounding research positioning and novelty claims are otherwise retained.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized grammar, terminology, notation, acknowledgment, and conference-footer edits while retaining the section sequence and most prose. Cross-reference wording changes throughout, sometimes incorrectly calling propositions, remarks, or corollaries 'Thm.'

P2.justification: Figure 3's legend associations change, several equation displays are regrouped, and text and figures reflow, including Figure 7 moving from page 40 to page 39. The figure/table inventory and remaining graphical content are retained.

improvement.justification: The revised Figure 3 legend resolves a contradiction with the retained ablation discussion, and the mathematical corrections improve internal consistency. Removing the additional Appendix E.4 derivation reduces explanatory detail, and some cross-reference labels become inaccurate, but these limited drawbacks do not outweigh the corrections to the existing evidence and formulas.
